title: Make numbers easier to work with

lessons.objective: Move a few counters and see why an awkward sum gets easier.
Count ten bags of sweets, then add the last bag.
See what half, a quarter and ten percent look like.

glossary.definition: The total when you add amounts together.
A share described as an amount out of every hundred.

outcomes: Explain the correction after rounding a number.
Multiply by 11 and handle a carry.
Build percentages from tenths, halves and quarters.
description: Turn awkward sums into easier ones. Start with counters and sweets, then explore what percentages really mean.
introduction: No need to remember a page of formulas. We’ll begin with small groups of things you can count, explain each step, and give you one little idea to try at a time.
prerequisites: Comfort with basic addition, subtraction and multiplication.
